name: The Attic Circle
summary: The Baron's son Victor is trying to leave Barovia by magic, and it is not going well for the servants.

stages.journal: Lady Lydia Petrovna says her son Victor hasn't come down from the attic in days, and two maids who carried up his meals have not come down at all.
objectives: Look in on Victor in the mansion attic

stages.journal: Victor has drawn a teleportation circle on the attic floor, copied out of a stolen spellbook. He means to leave Barovia through it. Two servants already tried it for him.
objectives: Talk Victor out of it, break the circle, or tell his father

stages.journal: Victor agreed to leave the circle alone. He hasn't forgiven us, but he's alive to hold the grudge.
We scuffed the circle's runes past mending. Victor will need years to draw another, if he can find the nerve.
We told the Baron about his son's attic. Victor's spellbook is locked in his father's study, and Victor hates us very precisely.
Victor stepped into his circle the day his father fell. There was a flash and a smell of hot iron. There is no Victor now.
